mission: Arrival at a modern Jedi outpost near Veranthos — two or three Jedi Knights on routine assignment, experiencing lattice distortion. Their practices failing, instincts unreliable, Force intuition blurring. The canary in the mine.
why_now: Grounds cosmic stakes in present-day human suffering — these are Ben's contemporaries, young Knights whose world is coming apart
conflict: The outpost Knights are frightened, disoriented, sending reports that read like stress complaints. They don't understand what's happening. Ben does — and he can't explain without revealing everything.
turning_point: A young Knight — about Ben's age — describes losing the ability to meditate. 'The Force is there but I can't... find the shape of it anymore.' Ben recognizes the description from the thin places. The lattice is thinning here.
opening_hook: The outpost looks normal from approach. The Knight who meets them at the landing pad does not look normal. His eyes are too wide and his hands are too still — the careful control of someone holding themselves together.
closing_hook: Torin watches the suffering Knights with an expression that is not compassion. It is calculation. He is measuring the cost of inaction against the cost of his proposed solution.
emotional_trajectory: Professional concern -> empathetic horror -> frustrated helplessness

stakes.personal: Ben seeing the real-world human cost of the seal's failure
stakes.interpersonal: The outpost Knights are Ben's peers — this could be him
stakes.external: The lattice distortion has reached occupied Jedi space

setting: Modern Jedi outpost — small installation, Outer Rim, near Veranthos
sensory_details: The outpost Knight's too-still hands; the Force here: unreliable, flickering; practice drills abandoned; the wrongness thicker than anywhere except the breach zone; young faces wearing expressions too old for them
notes: The outpost scene grounds abstract cosmic stakes in human faces. Ben's contemporaries — not ancient history, not theoretical. People his age whose Force connection is dissolving.
